finding.text: The owner asked for a Tasks tab "beside AI, Debug, Docs and Settings". Those four are the docked drawer's row, `ext/drawer/tabs.js:64-70`, and that row did not change: shots/1920.png and shots/3440.png still show "AI Debug Docs Settings Files" in the dock, with no Tasks. The diff only added a view to the routed `AIPage` (requirement 1 as the brief worded it). Add `{ name: "tasks", … load: () => import("./tabs/tasks.js") }` to `tabs.js`. The row must still fit on one line at the dock's 19rem; the 3440 shot already wraps "Files" onto a second line.

shots/400.png does not show the Tasks tab. It shows the phone sheet's chat (bubble, mic bar), because below 52em the sheet holds the screen. So the 400 proof the brief asked for is missing. Take the shot again with the sheet closed, or open Tasks from inside the sheet. If a phone can't reach Tasks at all, say so in the readme.

Stale readme: `ext/drawer/readme.md`'s Sheet bullet still says the AIPage's "views chat, live, sessions, debug and settings were the drawer's tabs". That list is missing tasks (and docs). The `tabs.js` bullet (line 31) lists "AI, Debug, Docs, Settings, Element"; it needs Tasks once fix 1 lands.

`TaskTally.js:7` copies the stop reasons that leave the count into its own `FAIR` list instead of reading `Task.FAIR_KINDS` (`core/Task/Task.js:226`). If the two lists drift apart, the tab and the task system will count differently. Import the list, or if Task.js can't load in node, leave a comment naming the one it copies.

A prompt with no title or text shows its raw id as the row's text: "p-1792961637996" in shots/1200.png, 5th row (`ChatV2Model.label` falls back to the id). The prompt's raw words or "(untitled ask)" would read better.

`tabs/tasks.js:12` stores the stream on `$d.tasks`, and nothing calls `unsubscribe()` when the tab closes. Each time the tab opens, a new tail starts on session.jsonl and keeps running in the background.
In `TaskTally.test.mjs:27-31`, the "bare prompt" assertions run after `console.log("ok")`. If they fail, the output has already said ok. Move them above that line.
At 3440 the list is a narrow column at the far left of a very wide empty page (shots/3440.png). This comes from the AIPage's own layout, not from this diff.

The diff does not belong to this task. `review/diff.patch` is commit f0de5d906 on `worktree/prompt-record` (the shared sentence splitter, refined `text` kept on replay, `doc/prompt-record.md`). This folder's `requirements.md` asks for the drawer's Tasks tab on `worktree/qf-4` (8c0c8736a), so none of its four deliverables can be checked against this diff. Re-run the review with the qf-4 diff, and file the prompt-record work under its own task folder.

Nothing indexes the prompt-record work (law 10). There is no task folder, requirements.md or task.jsonl for it, and the only mention outside the worktree is this diff.patch. A fresh agent cannot pick it up from here: it would not know the branch is unmerged, or who owns defects 1, 2, 6 and 7 in `doc/prompt-record.md`.

`doc/prompt-record.md` defects 3 and 5 say the fix belongs to `mastermind-dictation-2`, but no message to that agent exists (no hit in `Servex/agents/inbox.jsonl` or `ai/asks.jsonl`). Send the ask: `ChatV2Model.sentences` (`ext/Chat/v2/ChatV2Model.js:84-90`) should import `core/Task/sentences.js`, and the fold should honour `paragraphs.replace`.

`core/Task/sentences.js:1` says Prompt and `ChatV2Model.js` "both number a paragraph's sentences with it". Today only core does: the chat still uses its own regex at `ChatV2Model.js:87`. Until fix 3 lands, the comment should say "will".

`Prompt.text` now returns the smart seat's refined text, and the paragraph join has moved to `cleaned` (`Prompt.js:97-100`). The Server scripts that read `.text` (`PromptRecords.mjs:81,134`) use plain objects, not Prompt, so they are not affected. All tests pass in the worktree: Prompt 15/15, Question 6/6, Task 66/66, PromptsToSession 11/11.

Defect 7 ("a Prompt that needs no task never completes") affects this task's own count of "Done 7 of 39": every bare prompt is counted as open. Link it from the Tasks-tab readme bullet once both land.
